headline: Fair-value swing drives steep loss, though deficit narrows
summary_short: Revenue was $122.4M, up 6.9% y/y but down 1.6% q/q. Diluted EPS was -$24.45 (Q1: -$38.25; year-ago: +$32.60), with net loss narrowing to $8,219.6M from Q1's $12,542.7M loss but reversing a $10,020.8M profit a year earlier.
summary_long: Revenue was $122.4M, +6.9% y/y and -1.6% q/q. Gross profit was $81.6M, about 66.6% of revenue versus roughly 68.8% a year ago and 67.1% last quarter. Diluted EPS was -$24.45, versus -$38.25 in Q1 and +$32.60 a year ago. Net loss was $8,219.6M, narrower than Q1's $12,542.7M loss but a reversal from a $10,020.8M profit a year earlier. Cash fell to $1,711.8M from $2,207.2M q/q. Long-term debt fell to $6,709.9M.
